title: Page 1
slug: 娇妃要和离-风光-娘子人如其名温柔了时光款款向我走来-欸娘子别动手本郡王真不是故意成亲就失忆-谁能比她温柔倒楣郡王夫君成
content_zh:
编辑推荐 让你再次爱上我
如果重要之人对自己的记忆一夕之间消失，会是什么样的感觉？小编过去曾看过一部电影，叫做《我想念我自己》，女主角是一名大学教授，但她却罹患了早发性阿兹海默症，开始慢慢忘记身边的一切，整个人更开始变得不像自己。
她的儿女与丈夫也努力陪伴着她度过病痛，然而看着忘记自己、表现得像陌生人的妻子与母亲，家人们都非常痛心，却也知道不可能让她再度想起，只能努力培养新的回忆。
风光的《娇妃要和离》也有着类似的剧情，男主角宁化郡王崔静言在成亲当天遇袭，坠马后撞到头，醒来后忘了与女主角温柔过去三年浓情密意、培养感情的记忆，更惨的是，两人当初的相遇并不美好，温柔也不是崔静言向来欣赏的女子类型。
崔静言喜欢琴棋书画皆通、弱柳扶风的大家闺秀，温柔的名字虽看似达标，但身为镇守边疆的威武侯之女，在边关住了十多年的她从小就爱舞刀弄枪，甚至上战场杀过敌，曾真正立下军功。
当初是崔静言先苦苦追求温柔，为了她，文弱的他不惜夜半爬墙，只为与佳人相聚一刻，带着她湖上泛舟，湖边弹琴作画，即便温柔不懂这些风花雪月，甚至一展剽悍本色，在湖边抓了只鸭子现场烤了吃，崔静言都觉得可爱又迷人。
如今换成温柔追求他，失忆后的崔静言是抗拒这样「粗鲁不文」的女子的，然而温柔却很有自信的表示，会让他再次爱上她，就此展开追夫大计……
温柔是否能成功再度掳获崔静言的心？崔静言又能否想起失去的三年记忆？讨厌温柔的他用了许多手段想赶她走，不料这些竟都成为日后他「追妻火葬场」的现世报……如果你也喜欢甜甜蜜蜜、再续前缘的故事，千万不能错过！
序言 追妻火葬场
《娇妃要和离》这个故事，简而言之就是「傲娇一时爽，追妻火葬场」。
风光老早就想写一个男主角苦苦挽回的故事，甚至还坏心眼的想过干脆写个从第一章男主角就后悔，直直后悔了十一章，到最后一章才勉为其难的挽回了女主角的心。
不过真要这样写，风光可能会被编辑及读者钉到墙壁上，想想还是别让男主角那么惨，否则这本书看了可能心里要郁闷很久。
其实风光在思考形塑男主角崔静言这个人时，心中出现的范本是倩女幽魂中那个一点用都没有的书生宁采臣。
本书女主角温柔的性格爽朗，少有一般女人的细腻柔弱，多了英姿飒爽、敢爱敢恨。有了她的对比，如果男主角是宁采臣，想推倒就推倒，生气时一巴掌把他呼到天边去，光想想就令人兴奋得发抖。
然后这个构想被编辑打枪了。
这么弱的男主角谁要看啊？幸好风光及时想起来自己写的是罗曼史不是搞笑，更不是灵异，所以宁采臣就拜拜了，换来新的崔静言——足智多谋，暗怀武功，城府深沉到自己都忘光光，相信这样的男主角大家会比较喜欢，当他陷入追妻火葬场时，也比较容易自救。
其实故事到后来，风光还想多虐一下男主角，让温柔多气他几章，不过写着写着，风光也觉得这家伙实在是无辜，其实他什么也没干，就能让四周的人对他恨得牙痒痒，也算是他的本事。
严格说起来他并没有做坏事，就连失忆也不是他故意的，如果再继续虐下去，风光都不忍心了。再者，作者的心情容易随着剧情走，在写男女主角斗气的章节时，风光都觉得那阵子心头郁闷，脾气特别暴躁，晚上都睡不着。
所以最后写到温柔原谅他之后，那种心里的大石才像放了下去，顿时神清气爽，隔天睡到自然醒。
这样风格的故事，希望读者们会喜欢，因为这真是风光呕心沥血写出来的。

第一章 成亲当天失忆了(1)
温柔坐在床沿，面带忧愁又含情脉脉地看着床上昏迷不醒的男人。
纤手划过他英挺的剑眉、如帘般的浓长黑睫，顺着挺直的鼻梁划下，紧抿的唇不薄不厚，却失去血色，显示出了他的不适，他的肌肤不算白皙，也不到黝黑，肌理均匀轮廓深邃。
她一直知道他是俊美的，只是少有这种机会细细端详他。
这是她的夫，晋王三子崔静言，封号宁化郡王的男人。
今日是两人成亲之日，却在迎亲回晋王府的途中遭到贼人袭击。崔静言一介文人，哪里应付得来这等阵仗？反之身为威武侯之女的温柔，武功高强，当即由花轿飞身而出，脱下了凤冠赤手空拳与贼人搏斗起来。
只是贼人人数众多，顾此失彼，加上一身大红礼服着实碍手碍脚，最后崔静言落马撞了脑袋陷入昏迷。
幸而当时已离王府不远，王府亲卫前来支援，贼人见状不好，散逃而去，慌乱之中竟没能留住一个。
温柔虽也负伤，却顾不得那么多，她知道晋王府有驻府的太医，一把抄起崔静言直冲王府，看得一干亲卫反应不及，目瞪口呆，活了这么多年没见过这般猴急兼剽悍的新娘。
有了这么一场意外，原定的婚宴及拜堂仪式自然取消了。
幸而李太医诊断，崔静言身上并无严重外伤，只是后脑受了重击，醒来后可能会有一阵子恶心晕眩，至于有没有其他后遗症，等他醒来方能知晓。
李太医说崔静言随时会醒，所以温柔便一直陪在他身边，希望他张开眼后第一个见到的人是她，依他对她的情意，他该会欣喜的吧？
不知怎么，温柔总有些不安。
此时晋王夫妇及世子正在外头处理送客还礼的事，世子妃柳氏觑了个空来到新房之中，一眼看到案桌上仍燃烧着的大红喜烛，还有乏人问津的四喜果子以及合卺酒壶，对比床上不省人事的崔静言，还有刚入门的一身狼狈的弟媳妇，柳氏不由幽幽叹了口气。
「温姑娘……呃，弟妹，你也守了几个时辰，不如吃点东西……」因为崔静言拜堂前就昏迷，柳氏一时间反而不知该如何唤温柔了。
她端了些食物，关心的来到床沿，才发现温柔身上的喜服破了好几处，有些地方甚至还在渗血，不禁吓了一跳。「唉呀，你原来也受了伤，怎么没有说呢？」
血被喜服的大红盖过，当真不明显，加上温柔心急崔静言的伤势，自己都把这些伤口忽略过去，被这么一提醒，那些伤处还真有些刺痛起来。
温柔不在乎地一笑。「无妨的，崔静言的伤势比我重多了，方才情况混乱，哪里会注意到这么多。」
柳氏摇头，看得直蹙眉。「这样不成，我让人再去把李太医唤回来。」
她回身至房门口交代了几句，又折回来，到床边看了眼崔静言的情况，毕竟不好一直盯着小叔子，见没什么异状便退了几步，将手上的餐盘放到案桌上，说道：「你吃点东西垫垫肚子，不知三弟何时会醒，总不能饿着肚子等。」

「好的，大嫂，我待会儿吃。」温柔说是这么说，但目光还是不离崔静言。
柳氏深深地看了温柔一眼，有些改观。婚礼前她没有见过温柔，只听闻威武侯之女从小在边关长大，性格粗鲁不文、暴躁凶悍，还曾经随父亲上战场杀敌。
她猜测对方的长相应当也是五大三粗、貌不惊人，自家三弟崔静言可是仪表堂堂，城北徐公般的人物，不知怎么就看上了一个名声外貌皆不佳的武将之女，还坚持求娶。
content_en:
Editor's recommendation: Let you fall in love with me again
How would it feel if the memory of an important person disappeared overnight? The editor has watched a movie in the past called "I Miss Myself". The heroine is a university professor, but she suffers from early-onset Alzheimer's disease and begins to slowly forget everything around her, and her whole person begins to become less like herself.
Her children and husband also worked hard to accompany her through the illness. However, the family members were very sad to see their wife and mother who had forgotten them and behaved like strangers, but they also knew that it was impossible to remind her of her again and they could only work hard to cultivate new memories.
The beautiful "The Concubine Wants to Divorce" also has a similar plot. The male protagonist Cui Jingyan, the prince of Ninghua County, was attacked on the day of his wedding. He hit his head after falling from a horse. When he woke up, he forgot the memory of his deep affection and relationship with the heroine Wen Wen in the past three years. What's even worse is that the initial encounter between the two was not a good one, and gentleness is not the type of woman Cui Jingyan has always admired.
Cui Jingyan likes ladies who are good at piano, chess, calligraphy and painting, and who are weak in willow and wind. Although her gentle name seems to be up to standard, as the daughter of a powerful marquis guarding the border, she has lived in the border for more than ten years. She has been fond of wielding swords and guns since she was a child. She has even killed enemies on the battlefield, and has truly achieved military exploits.
It was Cui Jingyan who first pursued Gentleman. For her, he was so weak that he even climbed the wall in the middle of the night, just to be with the beautiful woman for a moment. He took her boating on the lake, played the piano and painted by the lake. Even though Gentleman didn't understand these romances, he even showed his rugged nature and caught a duck by the lake and roasted it on the spot. Cui Jingyan thought it was cute and charming.
Now it is Wen Wen who pursues him. Cui Jingyan, who has lost her memory, resists such a "rude and uncivilized" woman. However, Wen Wen's confident expression will make him fall in love with her again and start her plan to pursue her husband...
Can gentleness successfully capture Cui Jingyan's heart again? Can Cui Jingyan recall the three years of lost memories? He hates gentleness and uses many methods to drive her away. Unexpectedly, these will become the consequences of his "chasing his wife in the crematorium" in the future... If you also like sweet and sweet stories about rekindling a relationship, don't miss it!
Prologue Chasing Wife Crematorium
The story of "The Concubine Wants to Make Reconciliation" is, in short, "The proud concubine is having a moment of pleasure and chases her wife to the crematorium."
Feng Guang had long wanted to write a story about the male protagonist struggling to win back her love. He even had the evil intention of writing a story in which the male protagonist regretted it from the first chapter, regretted it for eleven chapters, and finally managed to win back the heroine's heart in the last chapter.
But if you really write it like this, the scenery may be nailed to the wall by editors and readers. Think about it, you should not make the male protagonist so miserable, otherwise you may be depressed for a long time after reading this book.
In fact, when Feng Guang was thinking about shaping the male protagonist Cui Jingyan, the model that came to mind was the useless scholar Ning Caichen in A Chinese Ghost Story.
The heroine in this book has a gentle and hearty personality. She is less delicate and weak than ordinary women, and more heroic and courageous, daring to love and hate. With her comparison, if the male protagonist is Ning Caichen, he can push him down if he wants, and when he is angry, he slaps him to the edge of the sky. Just thinking about it will make people tremble with excitement.
Then the idea was shot down by the editor.
Who wants to watch such a weak male protagonist? Fortunately, Feng Guang remembered in time that he was writing a romance, not a comedy, let alone a supernatural one, so Ning Caichen gave up and replaced him with a new Cui Jingyan - resourceful, secretly armed with martial arts, and so deep that he has forgotten everything. I believe that everyone will like such a male protagonist, and it will be easier for him to save himself when he is trapped in the crematorium of chasing his wife.
In fact, later in the story, Fengguang wanted to torture the male protagonist a little more and make Wenwen angry with him for a few more chapters. However, as the story went on, Fengguang also felt that this guy was really innocent. In fact, he didn't do anything, but he could make people around him hate him, which was his ability.
Strictly speaking, he didn't do anything bad. Even his amnesia was not his fault.It's funny, if the abuse continues, Fengguang won't be able to bear it anymore. Furthermore, the author's mood is easy to follow the plot. When writing the chapter where the male and female protagonists are fighting against each other, Fengguang felt that he was depressed at that time, his temper was particularly bad, and he couldn't sleep at night.
So in the end, after I wrote about tenderness and forgiving him, the big stone in my heart seemed to be relieved. I suddenly felt refreshed and slept until I woke up naturally the next day.
I hope readers will like this style of story, because it is really written by Feng Guang with great pains.
Chapter 1: Amnesia on the wedding day (1)
Wen Wen sat on the edge of the bed, looking at the unconscious man on the bed with a sad and loving expression.
Slender hands traced his handsome eyebrows, thick black eyelashes like curtains, and traced down the straight bridge of his nose. His tightly pursed lips were neither thin nor thick, but they lost their color, showing his discomfort. His skin was neither fair nor dark, with even texture and deep contours.
She had always known that he was handsome, but she rarely had the opportunity to look at him in detail.
This is her husband, Cui Jingyan, the third son of the Jin Dynasty, a man named Ninghua County Prince.
Today is the day for the two to get married, but they were attacked by thieves on their way back to Prince Jin's Mansion. How could Cui Jingyan, a scholar, be able to cope with such a battle? On the contrary, as the daughter of a mighty marquis, Gentle, with high martial arts skills, immediately flew out from the sedan chair, took off her phoenix crown and started fighting with the thieves with her bare hands.
It was just that there were so many thieves that they were concerned about one thing and not the other, and the bright red dress was really in the way. In the end, Cui Jingyan fell off the horse and hit her head and fell into a coma.
Fortunately, we were not far from the palace at that time, and the palace guards came to support. Seeing that the situation was not good, the thieves fled and fled. In the panic, they could not save any one of them.
Although Wen Wenwen was also injured, she didn't care so much. She knew that there was an imperial physician stationed in the Jin Palace, so she picked up Cui Jingyan and rushed straight to the palace. Seeing that the guards did not react in time, they were dumbfounded. She had never seen such an anxious and fierce bride in all her years.
With such an accident, the planned wedding banquet and church ceremony were naturally cancelled.
Fortunately, Dr. Li diagnosed that Cui Jingyan had no serious trauma, but suffered a heavy blow to the back of his head. He may feel nauseated and dizzy for a while after waking up. As for whether there are other sequelae, we will not know until he wakes up.
Doctor Li said that Cui Jingyan would wake up at any time, so Wen Wenwen stayed with him all the time, hoping that the first person he saw after opening his eyes would be her. Based on his affection for her, he should be happy, right?
Somehow, tenderness is always a little uneasy.
At this time, Prince Jin, his wife and the Crown Prince were dealing with seeing off guests and returning gifts. Crown Princess Liu took a break and came to the new room. She saw the bright red wedding candle still burning on the desk, as well as the unpopular Sixi fruit and the Hexin wine pot. Comparing the unconscious Cui Jingyan on the bed, and the embarrassed sister-in-law who had just entered the house, Lady Liu couldn't help but sigh.
"Miss Wen... uh, sister-in-law, you've been here for a few hours, why don't you have something to eat..." Because Cui Jingyan fell into a coma before worshiping, Mrs. Liu didn't know how to summon tenderness for a while.
She brought some food and came to the edge of the bed with concern, only to find that the wedding dress on Wen Wen's body was torn in several places, and some places were even bleeding, and she couldn't help but be shocked. "Oh, you were injured too, why didn't you say anything?"
The blood was covered by the bright red color of Xifu, so it was really not obvious. Coupled with the injuries of tender and impatient Cui Jingyan, he ignored these wounds. Being reminded like this, those wounds really stung a little.
Gentle and careless smile. "It doesn't matter. Cui Jingyan's injuries are much more serious than mine. The situation was so chaotic just now. How could he notice so much."
Ms. Liu shook her head and frowned. "If this doesn't work, I'll have someone call Dr. Li back again."
She turned back to the door of the room to explain a few words, then turned back and went to the bedside to take a look at Cui Jingyan's condition. After all, it was not easy to keep staring at her brother-in-law. When she saw that nothing was wrong, she took a few steps back and put the dinner plate in her hand on theOn the desk, he said: "Eat something to cushion your stomach. I don't know when my third brother will wake up, so we can't wait hungry."
"Okay, sister-in-law, I'll eat it later." Wen Wen said so, but her eyes still stayed on Cui Jingyan.
Mrs. Liu took a deep look at Wen Wen and felt a little changed. Before the wedding, she had never seen Wen Wen. She only heard that the daughter of Marquis Weiwu had grown up in the border gates. She had a rough and uncivilized personality, was irritable and fierce, and had even gone to the battlefield with her father to kill enemies.
She guessed that the other party's appearance should be thick and thick, and her appearance was not amazing. Her third brother Cui Jingyan was a handsome man, a man like Xu Gong in the north of the city. For some reason, he fell in love with the daughter of a military general with a poor reputation and appearance, and insisted on marrying her.
